title: A profile of Marc Andreessen, who sources say is close to White House COS Susie Wiles and has publicly described a fallout with Biden officials over AI policy (Austin Carr/Bloomberg)
summary: Austin Carr / Bloomberg: A profile of Marc Andreessen, who sources say is close to White House COS Susie Wiles and has publicly described a fallout with Biden officials over AI policy — The prominent investor has said the Biden administration pushed him to the political right, but sources say his grievances don't always match reality.
